title: T cells of donor CF-033
extract_protocol_ch1: To isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), peripheral blood was diluted 1:1 in 1x PBS and subjected to density gradient centrifugation using Pancoll human (PAN-Biotech, P06-1391500) at 800g for 20 minutes at room temperature. T cells were then isolated from PBMCs using the EasySep Human T cell Isolation Kit (Stemcell Technologies, 17951). The T cell fraction was then resuspended in a freezing medium composed of 90% FCS and 10% DMSO. Subsequently, the PBMCs were frozen using a Cryo-freezing container (Nalgene) and stored in liquid nitrogen for long-term preservation.  Thawed T cells underwent sorting using the FACS Aria III sorter, employing a 85-micron nozzle. DAPI-negative cells were sorted.

According to the manufacturer's instructions, single-cell RNA-seq libraries were generated using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Reagent Kits v2 by 10x Genomics (CG000330 Rev D). Briefly, a droplet emulsion was generated in a microfluidic chip, followed by barcoded cDNA and surface tag generation inside the droplets. Purified and amplified cDNA and surface tags were then subjected to NGS library preparation. The manufacturer's instructions generated T cell receptor sequencing libraries from amplified cDNA. Sequencing was performed on a NovaSeq 6000 instrument (Illumina). The read depth aimed for 30K reads per cell for GEX and ~20K for TCR libraries.

title: T cells of donor CF-018
extract_protocol_ch1: To isolate peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), peripheral blood was diluted 1:1 in 1x PBS and subjected to density gradient centrifugation using Pancoll human (PAN-Biotech, P06-1391500) at 800g for 20 minutes at room temperature. T cells were then isolated from PBMCs using the EasySep Human T cell Isolation Kit (Stemcell Technologies, 17951). The T cell fraction was then resuspended in a freezing medium composed of 90% FCS and 10% DMSO. Subsequently, the PBMCs were frozen using a Cryo-freezing container (Nalgene) and stored in liquid nitrogen for long-term preservation.  Thawed T cells underwent sorting using the FACS Aria III sorter, employing a 85-micron nozzle. DAPI-negative cells were sorted.

According to the manufacturer's instructions, single-cell RNA-seq libraries were generated using the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Reagent Kits v2 by 10x Genomics (CG000330 Rev D). Briefly, a droplet emulsion was generated in a microfluidic chip, followed by barcoded cDNA and surface tag generation inside the droplets. Purified and amplified cDNA and surface tags were then subjected to NGS library preparation. The manufacturer's instructions generated T cell receptor sequencing libraries from amplified cDNA. Sequencing was performed on a NovaSeq 6000 instrument (Illumina). The read depth aimed for 30K reads per cell for GEX and ~20K for TCR libraries.
data_processing: Sequencing libraries for gene expression and TCR was jointly processed using cellranger multi (v7.1.0) and the GRCh38 genome annotation
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: cellranger h5 output (gene expression), contig tables (VDJ)
